exposure: point anterior wall point A (Aa) position
cohort: The study included a consecutive series of women admitted to Chenghua District Maternal and Child Health Hospital (Chengdu, China) between November 2022 and February 2024, stratified by SUI diagnosis (249 cases in each group), with an external validation set of 74 non-SUI and 46 SUI patients from the same center between April and June 2025.
finding: A combined model incorporating various parameters, including age, gravida, parity, and imaging findings, is reasonably reliable in predicting the risk of SUI (AUC 0.861) but slightly less reliable for distinguishing its severity (AUC 0.783).
mod_finding: Delivery mode was identified as one of the parameters incorporated into the predictive model for stress urinary incontinence.
